Victoria Onufrio is a deceased human child found in the Szarr Palace guest room during Act Three. She has the rather unusual condition  Sapping Curse.

History

Victoria was the 'pureblooded' daughter of one of  Cazador's Vampire Spawn,  Leon Onufrio, who brought Victoria to the palace on Cazador's insistence. By consistently remaining his 'favoured spawn', Leon and Victoria were able to stay in the favoured spawn bedchambers together, where they were apart from the rest of the vampires.[1]

While at the palace, Leon became fearful for Victoria's life as other spawn showed interest in her. As a  Sorcerer, he imbued her with a counter-curse in the event of an attack against her person, making her a "necrotic booby-trap".[2]

Leon was finalising a deal with someone identified as Figaro, most likely  Figaro Pennygood, to procure a disguise for Victoria's escape.[1] However, she was found by the spawn  Dalyria, who brought her back to the palace. Dalyria was searching for a cure to vampirism and thought Victoria's young blood could help.[2] She bit into Victoria, killing her and triggering her necrotic curse.[3]

Involvement

Victoria can be found in the Szarr Palace guest room, which as Astarion explains is where 'guests' were kept until Cazador took them. He notes that there had been no prior deaths in the room, and that "something strange happened to that girl".

Her body and curse behave as an obstacle to obtaining the  Kozakuran Dictionary found in the guest room. The Sapping Curse can be removed with  Remove Curse, or an  Elixir of Necrotic Resistance can be used to move past her. If neither are available, as Victoria is a child and weighs little, she can be (somewhat morosely) tossed across the room, away from the rest of the objects within it.[4] If done in turn-based mode, this only incurs a single tick of damage.

The door to the guest room has the condition  Sinister Seal, which applies one round of sapping curse when opened normally. Opening the door with through  Mage Hand avoids taking damage.

Speak with Dead

It was possible to use  Speak with Dead on Victoria's corpse until Patch #5. Some of her then removed dialogue potentially contradicted in-game lore, such as saying that she was an orphan brought to Cazador by Dalyria.

  • Who are you?
    • Victoria
      Victoria... orphan...
  • How did you end up here?
    • Victoria
      Lady promised me food... shelter... took me here...
  • Do you know anything about the dictionary I found?
    • Victoria
      Lady who brought me here carried it... Hid it from monster...
      • What lady? Do you know her name?
        • Victoria
          Dalyria...
      • What did the monster look like?
        • Victoria
          Tall... long hair... terrible eyes...
      • What happened when you got here?
        • Victoria
          She held me... bit me... blood everywhere...
          • Did the lady kill you?
            • Victoria
              Tried but... couldn't drink... retching and gagging... then monster arrived...
              • Victoria
                Furious... she tried to disobey... not drink thinking creatures... he dragged her away...
